description:
## Why This Exists

post/smtp_relay.rs::extract_email_recipients() and extract_mail_from() use String::from_utf8_lossy() on the header section. Articles with Latin-1 encoded From/To headers (common in legacy Usenet) will have 0xFF and similar bytes silently replaced with U+FFFD, corrupting the address extraction and causing incorrect SMTP relay decisions.

did_passthrough.rs correctly avoids from_utf8_lossy. smtp_relay.rs should do the same: if header bytes are not valid UTF-8, return empty results (no relay).

## Acceptance Criteria

Replace from_utf8_lossy with from_utf8; on Err, return empty Vec/String.
title: smtp_relay: extract_email_recipients uses from_utf8_lossy on headers
